<script>
function switchLang(lang) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.lang-content').forEach(el => {
    el.style.display = el.classList.contains(lang) ? 'block' : 'none';
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.lang-button').forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.lang === lang);
  });
}
</script>

<style>
.lang-button {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  margin-right: 8px;
  background-color: #f3f3f3;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.lang-button.active {
  background-color: #808080;
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.lang-switch {
  margin-bottom: 1em;
}
</style>

<div class="lang-switch">
  <button class="lang-button active" data-lang="en" onclick="switchLang('en')">English</button>
  <button class="lang-button" data-lang="ko" onclick="switchLang('ko')">한국어</button>
</div>



<div class="lang-content en">

</div>

<div class="lang-content ko" style="display:none">

</div>
